segments.description: Accumulates and stakes TAO, Bittensor's native cryptocurrency, to generate yield and give investors exposure to the Bittensor ecosystem.
segments.evidence: The Company currently operates in three segments: (1) "Digital Assets", which represents the business surrounding our treasury activity with Bittensor,

segments.name: Managed Services
segments.description: Provides subscription-based network solutions and managed services for video collaboration to enterprise customers.
segments.evidence: We provide our customers with i) managed videoconferencing, where we set up and manage customer videoconferences, and ii) remote service management, where we provide 24/7 support and management of customer video environments.

segments.name: Collaboration Products
segments.description: Sells the Mezzanine™ family of turn-key visual collaboration products and related maintenance to office and operating center customers.
segments.evidence: Our product is called Mezzanine™, a family of turn-key products that enable dynamic and immersive visual collaboration across multi-users, multiple screens, multiple devices, and multiple locations.

revenueModel.text: The company earns staking rewards in TAO from delegating tokens to validators, subscription fees for network services, and direct sales of Mezzanine™ products and managed video collaboration services to customers.
revenueModel.evidence: Network services are offered to our customers on a subscription basis.
